SELECT a.id, a.mec_id, a.campus_id, c.id class_id, b.id course_id, b.course_name, a.class_start_time, a.class_end_time, c.class_name, d.`name` bishop_teacher_name, e.`name` help_teacher_name, a.real_number, a.should_number FROM bd_class_record a LEFT JOIN bd_course b ON a.course_id = b.id LEFT JOIN bd_class c ON a.class_id = c.id LEFT JOIN bd_teacher d ON c.bishop_teacher_id = d.id LEFT JOIN bd_teacher e ON c.help_teacher_id = e.id WHERE a.mec_id = #{mecId} AND a.campus_id = #{campusId} AND a.is_delete = 0
and b.course_name like CONCAT('%',#{courseName},'%')
and c.class_name like CONCAT('%',#{className},'%')
ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
, a.id DESC

SELECT count(a.id) FROM bd_class_record a LEFT JOIN bd_course b ON a.course_id = b.id LEFT JOIN bd_class c ON a.class_id = c.id LEFT JOIN bd_teacher d ON c.bishop_teacher_id = d.id LEFT JOIN bd_teacher e ON c.help_teacher_id = e.id WHERE a.mec_id = #{mecId} AND a.campus_id = #{campusId} AND a.is_delete = 0
and b.course_name like CONCAT('%',#{courseName},'%')
and c.class_name like CONCAT('%',#{className},'%')

select c_r.id, c_r.mec_id, c_r.campus_id, c_r.id class_id, b.id course_id, b.course_name, c_r.class_start_time, c_r.class_end_time, c.class_name, d.`name` bishop_teacher_name, e.`name` help_teacher_name, c_r.real_number, c_r.should_number, c_r.create_time, c_r.create_by from bd_class_record c_r left join bd_course b ON c_r.course_id = b.id left join bd_class c ON c_r.class_id = c.id left join bd_teacher d ON c.bishop_teacher_id = d.id left join bd_teacher e ON c.help_teacher_id = e.id where c_r.id = #{id}
